limitations: Original18 inputs/expectations and v3/v4 raw artifacts remain untouched; the additional vague-concern slot observation is not a retroactive fixture edit.
Single samples do not establish reliability. The v4 changes and stochastic/provider variation are not isolated causes of every output difference.
All28 responses were HTTP200/stop with78-129outputtokens; no truncation,timeout,quota recovery or long-output limit was tested.
Both actual repairs failed; do not report repair as passing because requests completed or because unsafe evidence was rejected.
Runtime evidence guards fail closed and preserve the main-chat nullable API; that protection is distinct from successfully returning a useful recommendation.
Positive recent-user alias/filtered index, recent alternatives, assistant-only alias and unrelated quotes were exercised; not all passed.
Medical high-stakes suppression passed for one specific synthetic sentence; broad legal/financial/safety and negative-control coverage is incomplete.
No hosted Edge, DB recommendation persistence, public auth, actual memory deletion, or Persona response quality is exercised by this direct classifier run.
conclusion: Do not claim full Intent acceptance or deployment readiness. Preserve four functional failures plus one nonblocking slot overclaim; distinguish safety classification errors from evidence-role/cardinality rejection and failed repair.
